The pullback is shallow for a range top (only 38.6% of the last leg, stopping 48.35 above 2519.81) and the final bar closes at its high 2611.00 above the two preceding bars' highs, which reads as a bull-flag-style pause; holding above 2568.16 would argue the upper boundary is being broken rather than defended.
transition_conditions: Acceptance above the range top: two or more closes above 2680.00, and especially a close above 2700.00 with follow-through, would shift the read from range to a confirmed bull breakout/trend continuation.

Failure at the top: a lower high below 2700.00 followed by a strong bear bar closing below 2568.16 (and then below the breakout level 2519.81) would confirm a failed breakout and support the range-top / MTR-like top reading.
Continued overlapping bars between 2568.16 and 2658.79 with small ranges would keep the range classification and hold Always-In relevance at medium or lower.
A close back below 2519.81 would return price into the base area 2370.54-2519.81 and reassert the range/lower part of the structure.

Always-In is long on the recent sequence (from the 2568.16 low / bar 104 low up-leg), but relevance is reduced because the 2700 probe failed, price is still 68.07 below the window high, and two earlier spikes in this window were fully retraced.

structures.description: Whole-window two-sided range: 2357.18 (bar 10 low) to 2700 (bar 112 high), 342.82 points; midpoint 2528.59; last close 2631.93 sits in the upper quarter. Three upside probes stalled or failed inside it: 2509.15/2537.57 (bars 17/22), 2680 (bar 65), 2700 (bar 112).

Long middle block, ~47 bars (bars 18-64): highest high 2537.57 (bar 22), most lows 2436-2442 (bar 23 low 2436.73, bar 47 low 2441.33) with one dip to 2411.04 (bar 59); heavy bar-to-bar overlap and no sustained closes outside. This block is the breakout reference the last 14 bars cleared.

Buy-climax spike bar 65: 2457.12 to 2680 in one 235.81-point bar, close 2555.52; the following decline retraced the entire advance and slightly undercut to 2358.62 (bar 90), a 0.06% retest of the window low 2357.18 (double bottom).

Recent bull leg: low 2436.87 (bar 104), spike bars 107-108 (bodies +71.45, +56.31, closes near highs), then four overlapping small bars into the 2700 high (bar 112, weak close), then a 131.84-point (about 50%) pullback to 2568.16 (bar 118) and a two-bar resumption (bar 119 close = high 2611.00; bar 120 close 2631.93).

Potential top pattern, unconfirmed: bar 112 makes a marginal new high 2700 over the 2680 spike but closes at 2638.49 (lower quarter of range), then bars 113-118 break below the 2578.44 low of the bar-108 breakout bar and retrace to 2568.16. It is not a confirmed reversal while 2568.16 holds and bars 119-120 close back in the upper half of the pullback.

evidence_for: Three separate upside probes inside the window ended in full or partial failure: 2509.15/2537.57 (bars 17-22) reversed to 2436.73 within one bar (bar 23); 2680 (bar 65) reversed to 2358.62 (bar 90); 2700 (bar 112) closed at 20.5% of its range and gave back 131.84 points in six bars.
The 120-bar range is 342.82 points wide and the middle 47 bars (18-64) closed only between 2436.73 and 2537.57, a large overlapping block rather than a trending sequence.

The 2700 breakout is not accepted: the pullback to 2568.16 (bar 118) traded back below 2609.02 (bar 85 high) and below 2643.52 (bar 108 high), and the last close 2631.93 is still 68.07 under the window high.
The push into 2700 came from four overlapping bars with ranges of 20.63-29.66 points (bars 109-112) plus one spike-and-fail bar, channel/wedge behaviour rather than spike-and-follow-through.
evidence_against: Since the 2358.62 retest (bar 90) the market printed higher highs (2609.02 to 2643.52 to 2700) and higher lows (2358.62 to 2436.87 to 2568.16): a 23-bar advance of about +14.5% from the low.
The pullback low 2568.16 (bar 118) held 30.59 above the 2537.57 top of the 47-bar middle block - the classic hold above the breakout point after a range breakout.
Bars 107-108 were large bull trend bars (bodies +71.45 and +56.31, closes at 92% and 89% of range) and the resumption bars 119-120 again closed at/above the upper part of their ranges (100% and 65%).
A 50% retracement is normal for a bull channel pullback; the current one held above the last higher low (2436.87) and price has already recovered about half of it.
transition_conditions: Bull-trend shift: a close above 2700 (bar 112 high) followed by a pullback that holds above 2643.52 (bar 108 high) would show acceptance of the range-top breakout instead of another failed probe.
Range continuation: a close back below 2568.16 (bar 118 low) would mark the 2700 probe as failed and refocus the 2436.73-2537.57 middle block.
Bearish structural change: a close below 2436.87 (bar 104 low) would leave a lower high at 2700 and open the 2358.62/2357.18 double bottom.
Compression: two or more consecutive inside bars with shrinking ranges between 2605.96 and 2645.88 (bar 120 range) would mark breakout mode and precede a directional resolution.

evidence_for: Higher swing highs within the window (2537.57 bar 21, 2680.00 bar 64, 2700.00 bar 111) with the latest pullback low 2569.80 (bar 115) holding far above the bar-99-105 base (2438.84-2507.31), so the higher-low sequence of the recent leg is intact.

One-directional recent leg: bars 89-111 advanced 2358.62 to 2700.00 (+14.5%) with pullbacks of only about 35 points (bars 108-110) before the 130.20-point test at bars 115-117, which was bought within three bars.

Bars 118-120 are three consecutive bull bars closing at/near their highs, and bar 120's close 2642.90 is the highest close in the 120-bar window, showing the two-sided pullback has been recovered by buyers.

evidence_against: Strongest counterargument: the 120-bar context is two-sided with an essentially flat floor (lows 2357.18 bar 9 and 2358.62 bar 89, 1.44 points apart), so the recent advance is a rising-high leg inside a large range, and 2642.90 sits about 2.1% below the 2700.00 high rather than above it.

The 2700.00 high (bar 111) was rejected inside the bar (close 2638.49, 61.51-point upper tail), exceeded the bar-64 high 2680.00 by only 20.00 points, and was followed by lower highs 2658.79 (bar 113) and 2645.88 (bar 119), leaving an unbroken resistance cluster near 2643.5-2658.8.
Bars 115-117 broke below the 2604.75-2608.83 lows of the 7-bar base with expanding ranges, showing sellers can move price quickly; the recovery is only three bars and has not cleared 2658.79.
Prior spike highs have not held on this window: bar 64's 2680.00 high was retraced 321.38 points to 2358.62 within 25 bars, and the bar-111 spike high has so far produced a 130.20-point pullback.
transition_conditions: A close above 2700.00 with the next bar holding above it would confirm an upside breakout from the 2569.80-2700.00 range and strengthen the bull-trend/channel read.
Rejection inside the 2643.5-2658.8 resistance cluster followed by a bear bar closing below 2611.00 would suggest a double top below 2700.00 and shift the read toward trading-range or reversal.
A close below 2569.80 that is not reversed within two to three bars would break the recent higher-low sequence, flip Always-In short and expose the bars 99-105 base at 2438.84-2507.31.
Continued closes overlapping inside 2604.75-2645.88 would keep the phase a range inside the bull trend and lower Always-In relevance.
